title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-purchase outings for George Washington University students, centered on free museums and art spaces reachable from Foggy Bottom.

cards.title: Compare Contemporary Craft at the Renwick
cards.subtitle: A free gallery meetup steps from the White House
cards.notes: Meet at the 17th Street entrance, choose one craftwork each, then regroup to compare materials, scale, and technique.
cards.short_summary: Turn a free decorative-arts visit into a relaxed visual comparison game.
cards.evidence_claim: The Renwick Gallery presents craft and decorative art; admission is always free, and general visitors do not need tickets.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 10:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. except December 25; admission is always free and no ticket is required.

cards.title: Run a Natural-History Exhibit Hunt
cards.subtitle: A free group challenge on the National Mall
cards.notes: Have each person pick a specimen or object to photograph, then meet in the rotunda and explain what made the selection memorable.
cards.short_summary: Explore fossils, specimens, and cultural objects through a shared exhibit hunt.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Museum of Natural History states that museum admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; visitors pass through security, and the museum recommends reviewing current visitor guidance before arrival.

cards.title: Trade Object Stories at American History
cards.subtitle: A free museum hang with no entry pass
cards.notes: Split up to find one object tied to everyday American life, then reconvene and give the group a two-minute curator-style introduction.
cards.short_summary: Use collection objects as prompts for a casual round of historical storytelling.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the National Museum of American History is always free, and advance registration is not required for general group visits.
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free. General visitors do not need advance registration; larger groups are encouraged to divide into smaller groups.

cards.title: Try Slow Looking at Asian Art
cards.subtitle: Nine guided activities with free, unticketed entry
cards.notes: Pick one artwork and look silently for several minutes before sharing details each person noticed, using the museum's guided activities.
cards.short_summary: Slow down together and compare observations inside two connected galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Museum of Asian Art is always free, requires no entry ticket, and offers nine guided activities for structuring a visit.
cards.source_title: Visit - National Museum of Asian Art
cards.access_notes: Open daily 10:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. except December 25; admission is always free and no entry ticket is needed.

cards.title: Start a Gallery Conversation at African Art
cards.subtitle: Free admission with no timed ticket
cards.notes: Choose one work from Africa or its diaspora, read its label together, and discuss how its material or setting shapes your interpretation.
cards.short_summary: Build a thoughtful group conversation around art from Africa and its diaspora.
cards.evidence_claim: Entrance to the National Museum of African Art is always free and does not require a timed ticket.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | National Museum of African Art
cards.access_notes: Open daily 10:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. except December 25; general admission is free and requires no ticket.

cards.title: Make a Contemporary-Art Loop at the Hirshhorn
cards.subtitle: Free galleries, sculpture, and self-guided interpretation
cards.notes: Begin with the outdoor sculpture, circle the galleries together, and use the museum's mobile guide to compare artist context afterward.
cards.short_summary: Pair striking contemporary works with a free self-guided group circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hirshhorn offers free admission, free self-guided digital content, and access to its collection and sculpture campus.
cards.source_title: Visit - Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden
cards.access_notes: Free admission. Open Monday noon–5:30 p.m. and Tuesday–Sunday 10:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; select exhibitions may require passes.

cards.entity_name: National Gallery of Art Sculpture Garden
cards.title: Walk the Sculpture Garden Clockwise
cards.subtitle: A free self-guided route among monumental works
cards.notes: Start at the northwest Constitution Avenue entrance, follow the official clockwise route, and pause for one group photo discussion.
cards.short_summary: Follow an official outdoor route through monumental modern sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Gallery provides a self-guided clockwise tour of the Sculpture Garden, and admission to the garden is always free.
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free. Follow posted garden rules and check the current visit page for seasonal hours or event-related closures.

cards.entity_name: National Gallery of Art West Building
cards.title: Pick One Work in the West Building
cards.subtitle: Free pre-20th-century galleries with no ticket
cards.notes: Give everyone twenty minutes to choose one work, then gather in the Rotunda and visit each selection as a group mini-tour.
cards.short_summary: Let each friend curate one stop in a collaborative gallery itinerary.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Gallery's West Building displays art from the 11th through early 20th centuries; admission is always free with no pass or ticket needed.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | National Gallery of Art
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free and no ticket or pass is needed. Open daily 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; all visitors enter through security.

cards.entity_name: National Gallery of Art East Building
cards.title: Pair Architecture with Modern Art
cards.subtitle: A free East Building exploration with no pass
cards.notes: Meet in the light-filled atrium, trace the building's angles from different levels, then compare them with one modern artwork each.
cards.short_summary: Make the East Building's geometry part of a shared modern-art outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Gallery identifies the East Building as home to modern and contemporary art, a roof terrace, and an atrium; admission is always free without tickets.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | National Gallery of Art
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free and no ticket or pass is needed. Open daily 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; all visitors enter through security.

cards.title: Hunt for Design Details at the Postal Museum
cards.subtitle: A free museum outing with no general-entry pass
cards.notes: Look for one stamp, vehicle, or postal object whose design catches your eye, then compare choices and the stories they communicate.
cards.short_summary: Use postal artifacts and graphic design as prompts for an easy group challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Postal Museum among its Washington museums and states that Smithsonian museum admission is free; only four listed sites require free entry passes, excluding this museum.
cards.access_notes: General admission is free, and the Smithsonian's current ticket guidance does not list this museum as requiring an entry pass.
